title: Granted rules text on attached Equipment
explanation: Attached Equipment has only its printed rules text inactive. Rules text granted by another effect remains active, so Temporary granted by Turn to Dust will trigger and kill it in its controller's next Beginning Phase; granted Deflect also remains active.
